title: Topic 10: Food & Drink / Ordering - Speaking
description: Recorded speaking task, teacher-graded against a 4-criterion rubric.
canDoStatement: Order food and drink in a cafe; say what you like

speakingTask.speakingPrompt:
Record yourself. You are in a cafe - order!
Say 4 things:
1. Greet the waiter (Good morning!)
2. Order 2 things: Can I have ... and ..., please?
(careful: a coffee, but AN apple!)
3. Ask the price: How much is it? (T9)
4. Say one thing you like: I like...
